name: Rachana Infrastructure Ltd.
summary: Rachana Infrastructure Ltd. is an Indian infrastructure and civil construction company primarily engaged in the execution of civil construction projects. The company operates as an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contractor, focusing on the development and maintenance of roads and highways, including four-lane, two-lane, state highways, and urban development roads. It also undertakes irrigation projects such as pipeline laying and canal excavation, along with general pipeline laying services for gas. Additionally, Rachana Infrastructure Ltd. is involved in building construction for schools, colleges, and hostels, and conducts mining and quarrying activities to support its construction projects. The company primarily serves government authorities and public sector undertakings in Gujarat and surrounding states, and also works on private projects for buildings, roads, and industrial parks.
